text.card: A star about 110 parsecs away, 3.8 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.8 solar radii and 3.16 solar masses (FLAME) and 10,514 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Iota Coronae Borealis
quotes.card: Iota Coronae Borealis is a binary star system in the northern constellation of Corona Borealis.
quotes.introduction: It has the proper name Aurwandilsta; Iota Coronae Borealis is its Bayer designation, which is Latinized from ι Coronae Borealis and abbreviated Iota CrB or ι CrB.
